Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: proposed website ambassador character extension for NetBet Max, isolated transparent PNG asset.

Identity and rendering authority: reference image 1 (ref-08.png) is the SAME Max character that must be preserved, not reinvented. Preserve his recognizable mature, warm, wry face; swept voluminous silver-white hair; dark, expressive arched eyebrows; black rectangular eyeglasses; neat short white beard and moustache; warm skin; slim elegant shoulders/waist; and deliberately exaggerated very long slender legs. Match image 1's polished high-end stylized 3D rendering, smooth dimensional modeling, tailored fabric realism, carefully sculpted hands, and expressive face. Do not make him photorealistic, younger, broader, stockier, or normally proportioned.

Reference image 2 (ref-19.png) is supporting guidance ONLY for the small chest emblem convention: a gold "NB" mark with the tier shield attached directly below, placed on Max's anatomical LEFT chest, which appears on the viewer's RIGHT. Preserve that side. Ignore its cane, backdrop, trousers, pose and pink badge. Use the separately supplied tier badge reference for the actual badge. No cane in the new image.

Composition: one character only, fully visible from hair through BOTH shoe soles; all fingers and BOTH hands visible. Upright portrait 1024x1536 or same 2:3 aspect ratio. The character occupies about 84% of image height with generous clear margins around hair, fingertips, coat tails and shoes. Center the full figure so gesture stays in frame. Genuinely transparent alpha background; no white or black rectangle, no fake checkerboard, no scenery, no platform, no ground plane and no large cast shadow. Soft neutral studio key and rim lighting to read well on a website.

Brand details: tiny tasteful gold letters "NB" above a small attached tier shield on CHARACTER LEFT chest / VIEWER RIGHT. Small N-engraved cuff buttons. No other readable text, name tag, floating graphics or extra badges. No arbitrary extra ornaments. No watermark. This is a proposed ambassador visual, not a canonical brand approval.

Input image roles: 1 is Max identity/proportions/rendering; 2 is chest emblem placement only; 3 is garment structure/colors from the navy Regency coat, brown-gold waistcoat and cream trousers, NEVER the young model's face; 4 is navy frock coat and restrained narrow gold piping only, NEVER the young model's face; 5 is exact GOLD tier chest shield shape and materials.
Ensemble GOLD / welcome: an impeccably fitted navy Regency-inspired cutaway/frock coat with narrow gold piping, brown-gold subtly floral brocade waistcoat, ivory shirt and softly tied pale ivory cravat. A restrained single pocket-watch chain. CREAM high-waisted tailored trousers with crisp pressed creases, clearly cream all the way to the hem. BROWN polished leather Oxford lace-up shoes, clearly brown. No black trousers or black footwear. The small tier shield is the unwinged golden faceted shield with a silver-blue rim in image 5; no wings, no red gem.
Pose: relaxed elegant contrapposto with the same improbably long-legged proportions as Max in image 1. Face turned warmly toward the viewer with a wry inviting smile. Max's left forearm extends toward VIEWER RIGHT, his left palm open and gently upturned in a natural welcome/presentation gesture for adjacent landing page copy. His right arm rests relaxed near his front/side with right hand fully outside the pocket and all fingers visible. Hands anatomically coherent with five natural fingers each. Keep both hands separate from the chest badge. No hand in a pocket, no cane, no prop.
